Initial release of Automation Workflow Helper.

- Identify and evaluate high-value opportunities for automating repetitive tasks.
- Compare workflow automation platforms (Dify, Coze, n8n) and Robotic Process Automation (RPA), with clear use-case guidance.
- Step-by-step process for selecting the right automation approach based on task type and system capabilities.
- Includes ROI calculation, process template design, and actionable flow design guidance.
- Recommends specific tools (including open-source options) and provides quick-start links and installation instructions.
